candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502. Traces show payment 503 errors propagating through order to /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side logs/metrics excluded; root cause within payment (config, resource) not established.

report.explanation: Checkout returns 502 in ~50-95ms. Traces show order's call to payment returning 503, propagating as 502 to gateway. Inventory/redis calls succeed. Bounded candidate: payment service failing (http-500 class) causing checkout 502s.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs and metrics to confirm 503 origin and cause
Excluded gateway logs (ev-...-gw_logs) to corroborate error path
